points.description: Names the Maxwell–Betti reciprocal theorem (Betti's theorem / Maxwell's reciprocal theorem / reciprocal theorem of work).
points.partial_credit: 1 mark if only a related idea is given, e.g. 'reciprocal theorem' is not named but 'Maxwell's law' or 'Betti's law' alone, or a vague reference to reciprocity or work/energy.

rubric.notes: Full marks for naming Maxwell–Betti reciprocal theorem in any form, including Betti's theorem or Maxwell's reciprocal theorem alone. Give 1 mark for a vague or related answer such as reciprocity, or reciprocal work/energy idea without the name. Give 0 for unrelated theorems (e.g. Castigliano, superposition only).
